extDescription.message: Spots duplicate tabs: a badge shows when the current page is already open, and one click takes you to it or closes the copies.

helpLink.description: Link under the mode select to open the help page.

pause.description: Button label to pause duplicate tab detection.

resume.description: Button label to resume duplicate tab detection.

paused.message: Detection is paused: no badges and no automatic switch.
paused.description: Status message when extension is paused.

helpIntro.message: 1Tab spots tabs showing the same page: the extension icon shows the number of copies of the current page, and the popup lists all duplicates so you can go to them or close them. Three modes decide when two pages are “the same”. In every mode, http/https, letter case of the host and a leading “www.” are ignored, while the port matters (localhost:3000 ≠ localhost:8080).

helpExactDesc.message: Same host, path and query string (case-sensitive). The order of query parameters, tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid…) and anchors (#section) are ignored. Hash routes used by web apps (#/inbox) are compared.

helpPathDesc.message: Same host and path; the query string and the hash are ignored. Warning: with this mode you cannot keep two searches open on most search engines.

helpDomainDesc.message: Same host: one tab per site. Subdomains other than “www” are different sites (mail.google.com ≠ www.google.com).

helpBehaviorBackground.message: Links opened in the background (Ctrl+click, middle click) are never closed automatically: they only get the badge.

helpBehaviorIgnored.message: Browser pages (new tab, settings, extensions…), local files and popup windows are ignored.

helpBehaviorIncognito.message: Incognito tabs are only compared with other incognito tabs.

badgeTitle.message: This page is open in $1 tabs

currentDuplicated_one.message: This page is also open in another tab.

currentDuplicated_other.message: This page is also open in $1 other tabs.

closeCopies.message: Close the copies of this page

autoSwitchHint.message: A page opened in the foreground that is already open closes and takes you to the existing tab.

helpBehaviorAutoSwitch.message: Automatic switch (off by default): a new tab opened in the foreground on a page that is already open is closed and the existing tab is activated. Only new tabs are concerned (including a new tab page where you type an address): navigating inside an existing tab never closes it.

helpBehaviorCleanup.message: When closing duplicates, the current tab is kept if it is one of them, otherwise the most recently used one. Pinned tabs are never closed.
